items.proposed: keep IDH row as eligibility, candidate_matched false; any_molecular_selection false
items.reason: "The pathology of the tumor is glioblastoma (IDH wild-type, WHO grade 4)" is a diagnostic criterion; the manual says IDH-wildtype is never candidate-matched and is excluded from any_molecular_selection when used only to define GBM. The trial is excluded at S6 anyway (temozolomide established_therapy_experiment).
